series_start_reason: Series starts 2020Q1, the launch quarter (Biohaven's first-quarter 2020 Form 10-Q: 'Approved by the FDA on February 27, 2020 and commercialization begun March 2020'). Biohaven Pharmaceutical Holding (CIK 1689813) booked Nurtec ODT, its only product, through 2022Q2; Pfizer closed the acquisition on October 3, 2022 and prints 'Nurtec ODT/Vydura' from 2022Q4. 2022Q3 is unpublished (see unreported_quarters).
search_log: listed filings of the issuer via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages), all forms incl. 8-K and 8-K/A (CIK 0000078003); Q4 2022 - Q2 2026 releases parsed for the Nurtec ODT/Vydura row
Pfizer Q3 2022 release/10-Q (Oct 2 2022 quarter end, one day before closing) carries no Nurtec revenue; Q3 2023 release prior-year column prints a dash for Q3 2022

[g4_us extension 2026-11] Joined Biohaven's series (rows of companions/biohaven_nurtec_odt_quarterly.csv, 2020Q1-2022Q2, Biohaven 8-K Exhibit 99.1 'Product revenue, net', each re-verified by verify_staged_manifests.py) to Pfizer's. Listed Biohaven (CIK 1689813) 10-Q/10-K 2020-2022 and read 'Product revenue, net': the 10-Qs print 1,151 / 9,698 / 17,664 (2020Q1-Q3), the 2020 10-K quarterly table 35,114 for 2020Q4, matching the releases; last 10-Q is for 2022-06-30.

Scope note: Biohaven prints one product revenue line, which is Nurtec ODT (its only commercial product) and is its company-wide total; Pfizer's line is worldwide Nurtec ODT/Vydura. Both are the issuer's total for the product, so the joined series is the issuer-total (worldwide) line; Biohaven's sales were principally U.S. Checks: 2020 quarters sum to 63,627 thousand and 2021 quarters to 462,509 thousand, the full years printed in the Q4 releases.
Pfizer 2022Q3 (release filed 2022-11-01) prints no Nurtec line; listed Pfizer item 2.02 8-Ks 2022-06 to 2023-06.

unreported_quarters.2022Q3: Ownership change Biohaven to Pfizer; no figure for the quarter is published. Pfizer completed the acquisition of Biohaven Pharmaceutical Holding on October 3, 2022; Biohaven's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2022 (8-K closing 2022-10-03, 15-12G 2022-10-14), and Pfizer's third-quarter 2022 release prints no Nurtec ODT line (its first is the fourth-quarter 2022 release).
